legalModal.p1: 1. Data Collection: We collect professional contact information necessary for facilitating business matching and event registration (e.g., name, company, job title, email address).
legalModal.p2: 2. Use of Information: The information is exclusively used to organize 1:1 business consultations, provide event updates, and coordinate logistics prior to and during the BILATERAL SUMMIT 2026.
legalModal.p3: 3. Data Sharing: Your professional details may be shared with matching counterparties (Korean or Vietnamese companies) specifically for the purpose of scheduling consultations. Data will not be sold to third-party marketers.
legalModal.p4: 4. Security: We implement industry-standard security measures to ensure your data is protected against unauthorized access or disclosure.
legalModal.p5: 5. Your Rights: You have the right to request access to, modification, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team.
legalModal.t1: 1. Event Participation: Registration for the BILATERAL SUMMIT 2026 does not guarantee confirmation. The organizers (KOSME & Tech Valley) reserve the right to select participants based on business relevance and matching capacity.
legalModal.t2: 2. Code of Conduct: All delegates are expected to conduct themselves professionally. The organizers reserve the right to revoke access for any inappropriate behavior.
legalModal.t3: 3. Media Release: By attending the event, you consent to being photographed or recorded. These materials may be used for promotional and archival purposes.
legalModal.t4: 4. Intellectual Property: Any materials, presentations, or data shared during the keynote sessions or 1:1 consultations remain the intellectual property of their respective owners.
legalModal.t5: 5. Liability: The organizers are not liable for any direct or indirect business outcomes, partnerships, or agreements that arise from consultations held during the summit.
